The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.653, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas injected into the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, unsupported functions, or incorrect syntax. While basic structure and net metrics passed, the statistical summary block is broken.
